title: Builtbyswami Weekly #5: Robotaxis land in Europe, EA leaves Wall Street, and DeepSeek's quiet double move
teaser: Uber and Pony.ai put 2,000 driverless robotaxis on European roads, EA closed the biggest buyout in history and walked off the stock market, DeepSeek shipped a cheap open model and a humanoid-robot partnership in the same week, 2026 became the worst data-breach year on record, and the Pixel 11 landed the first 2nm phone chip.
